register_sales_tax.title: Register for Nevada Sales Tax
register_sales_tax.summary: If you have physical nexus (FBA inventory) or economic nexus ($100,000 OR 200 transactions (includes marketplace sales)) in Nevada, registration is required.

steps.title: Register with Nevada DOR
steps.detail: Apply as a remote seller. Threshold: $100,000 OR 200 transactions (includes marketplace sales). State has marketplace-facilitator FBA carve-out — FBA inventory alone may not create nexus.
steps.verification_check: Receive a Nevada sales tax permit/license number.

steps.title: Note filing frequency and due dates
steps.detail: Typical: monthly filing. Returns typically due the 20th of the month following the period. Verify assigned frequency after registration.

steps.title: Configure Shopify and update dashboard
steps.detail: Enable NV tax collection in Shopify for direct orders. Amazon handles marketplace orders. Mark NV as registered in the dashboard.

franchise_or_entity.title: Nevada Commerce Tax
franchise_or_entity.summary: NV Commerce Tax applies to businesses with >$4M Nevada-sourced gross revenue. High threshold; unlikely for most small sellers but monitor as revenue grows.

steps.title: Review entity-level obligations with CPA
steps.detail: Nevada Commerce Tax applies to businesses with Nevada gross revenue over $4M. Unlikely for most small sellers but flag if revenue grows.

marketplace_facilitator_notes.title: Amazon Marketplace — Nevada
marketplace_facilitator_notes.summary: Amazon collects and remits NV sales tax on marketplace orders. This does not eliminate registration or filing obligations.

steps.title: Amazon handles sales tax on Amazon orders
steps.detail: You do not owe additional sales tax on Amazon-facilitated orders.

steps.title: Register and file if nexus exists
steps.detail: If you have physical or economic nexus, registration may be required. Returns show Amazon-collected amounts as marketplace deductions.

steps.title: Collect on Shopify/direct
steps.detail: You are responsible for collecting and remitting on direct (Shopify) orders shipped to NV.
